question_text: A 22-year-old man presents to the emergency department with a fever and a sore throat. He has had these symptoms for the past 2 weeks and has felt progressively more fatigued. His temperature is 102°F (38.9°C), blood pressure is 120/68 mmHg, pulse is 100/min, respirations are 17/min, and oxygen saturation is 98% on room air. Physical exam is notable for tonsillar exudates, posterior cervical lymphadenopathy, and splenomegaly. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in management for this patient?
